text:
maya: Hey folks — opened a PR to refresh the Quickstart Hello (minimal) auth snippets. SDK v4->v5 changed the token flow; current docs show the old curl + query param pattern. Can reviewers take a quick look? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/431

oliver: On it. @laura can you check the TypeScript example? Want to avoid landing this right before the SDK release if it still references old APIs.

laura: Skimmed the diff. Payload shape and auth entrypoints changed — we should show the new minimal server approach. Proposed TS snippet below (short):
```ts
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const out = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/compact-1', prompt: 'Hello' });
  res.json(out);
}
```
Note: use Authorization header in examples, not ?token= in URLs.

sam: Also update the curl example to use `-H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY"` — currently it shows `?token=` which we removed from the server side.

maya: Good catch. @docs-bot can you run snippet lint and linkcheck on the branch before we merge? I pushed a tiny note about token rotation too.

docs-bot: auto: Running snippet-linter and linkcheck on 431... found 1 lint warning (TS async handler missing try/catch) and 2 broken links.

oliver: Which links are 404s?

docs-bot: auto: Broken: /api/old-auth-ref -> 404, /examples/hello-old -> 404. Looks like both were moved in the recent examples reorg.

laura: I can update the examples directory references and repoint the anchor to /examples/hello-minima. Will push fix in a follow-up commit to the same branch.

maya: I fixed the curl snippet and added a short paragraph about rotating API keys and recommended TTL. Pushed. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/431/files

sam: LGTM besides the lint nit. Suggest squash commits and add a single changelog entry under "Quickstart" for audit.

oliver: :thumbsup: merging once CI is green. I'll queue a docs patch deploy after merge and coordinate a small blurb in the release notes.

docs-bot: auto: CI checks passed. Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-431--docs.redwood.ai/hello

maya: Preview looks good on mobile and desktop. Thanks y'all :rocket:

laura: Tiny nit — change one remaining "auth token" -> "API token" wording in the Getting Started paragraph. I'll open a 1-line PR against main after this merges.

sam: Cool. I'll squash and merge now, then close out the branch.

maya: Thanks everyone, closing the thread after merge. :white_check_mark:
